mapper.select: SELECT id FROM orch_run WHERE deleted = FALSE AND (status = 'READY' OR (status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until < #{now})) ORDER BY create_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE orch_run SET status = 'LEASED', worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
